offering_description.value: Rents construction and industrial equipment, aerial work platforms, earthmoving machines, power, pumps and trench safety gear to contractors, industrial firms and municipalities. Operates a large branch network and also sells used equipment, new equipment, parts and contractor supplies.

primary_products.value: used rental equipment; new equipment; contractor supplies; parts and merchandise

primary_services.value: general equipment rental; specialty equipment rental (power, pumps, trench safety, fluid solutions); delivery and pickup; repair and maintenance services

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction contractors, industrial plants, utilities, event and commercial customers; B2G: municipalities and government agencies; B2C: homeowners and DIY customers, a small share

end_markets.value: non-residential construction; industrial manufacturing; infrastructure; utilities; energy; events

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: equipment rental by day, week or month; product sales: used equipment, new equipment, parts and contractor supplies; service fees: delivery, fuel, repair and maintenance, and damage waiver charges
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates a large rental fleet bought from equipment manufacturers, rented to contractors and industrial users; distributor: resells used equipment, parts and contractor supplies

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Europe, plus a small presence in Australia and New Zealand

specialization.value: related lines: general rental, specialty rental (power, pumps, trench, fluid solutions), and equipment and supplies sales

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated rental branches and specialty locations; direct sales: key account sales teams serving large contractors and industrial customers; online: online reservation and equipment management platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: equipment safety, emissions and environmental rules (OSHA, EPA), vehicle transport rules and hazardous materials handling

notes: Geography detail for Europe and Australia/New Zealand is from memory and may be outdated; the main business is North America.
